IVX HOLDINGS — FINAL AI DEVELOPMENT AND BUSINESS ACTIVATION MANDATE

COMPLETE IVX IA SENIOR DEVELOPER
BUILD THE 50-AGENT APP FACTORY
ACTIVATE EVERY VERIFIED AI IN THE BUSINESS WORKFLOW

OWNER: Ivan Cifuentes
START TIME: IMMEDIATELY UPON RECEIPT
MASTER TARGET: 30 CALENDAR DAYS
OPERATING MODEL: CONTINUOUS QUEUE-BASED EXECUTION WITH LIVE EVIDENCE

This is an execution mandate.

Do not return only a plan, mockup, simulation or narrative report.

Rork must configure the execution infrastructure and assign IVX IA Senior Developer to complete the system end to end.

Every agent that passes security, QA and production verification must immediately begin useful work. Do not wait for all 50 agents to be completed before activating verified agents.

==================================================================
1. FINAL REQUIRED OUTCOME
==================================================================

Deliver two separate, owner-controlled systems:

SYSTEM A — IVX HOLDINGS PRODUCTION AI WORKFORCE

Purpose:

- Complete and maintain the existing IVX application.
- Operate IVX business workflows.
- Acquire and manage investors and buyers.
- Manage deals, marketing, CRM, finance and reporting.
- Protect production systems and business data.

SYSTEM B — INDEPENDENT 50-AGENT APP FACTORY

Purpose:

- Research new software opportunities.
- Design applications from scratch.
- Develop mobile, web and backend systems.
- Test, secure, deploy and maintain applications.
- Create multiple independent applications.
- Remain isolated from IVX production data and financial systems.

Both systems remain under Ivan Cifuentes’s final authority.

==================================================================
2. TIME CONTROL
==================================================================

Record these timestamps in the autonomous dashboard:

- Mandate received time.
- Actual execution start time.
- Start time for every phase.
- Start time for every agent.
- Last heartbeat.
- Estimated completion.
- Actual completion.
- QA completion.
- Security approval.
- Production activation.
- Business-workflow activation.

The clock begins at T0 when this mandate is received.

Do not alter deadlines silently.

If a deadline cannot be met, report:

- Exact blocker.
- Root cause.
- Work completed.
- Work remaining.
- Evidence.
- Corrected completion estimate.
- Agent responsible.
- Recovery action.

==================================================================
3. MASTER DELIVERY SCHEDULE
==================================================================

PHASE 0 — CONTROL, ACCESS AND BASELINE

START:
T0 — Immediately

TARGET END:
T0 + 4 hours

Required outcomes:

- Verify owner authority.
- Verify active GitHub repository and branch.
- Verify Render.
- Verify Supabase.
- Verify Expo and EAS.
- Verify AWS and DNS where applicable.
- Verify secrets and variables load at runtime.
- Verify emergency stop.
- Verify audit ledger.
- Create the authoritative backlog.
- Record the current production baseline.
- Create backup and rollback references.
- Identify every simulated, incomplete and genuinely operational agent.

PHASE 1 — IVX IA SENIOR DEVELOPER CORE

START:
T0

TARGET END:
T0 + 24 hours

Required outcomes:

- IVX IA Senior Developer has authenticated tools.
- It can inspect and modify the repository.
- It can create branches, commits and pull requests.
- It can run tests.
- It can read logs.
- It can query the production database safely.
- It can trigger approved builds and deployments.
- It can validate live production.
- It can report exact failures.
- It can continue tasks from a persistent queue.
- It can recover after restart.
- It appears in the live Owner Dashboard.

Do not call IVX IA complete unless these capabilities are demonstrated with real evidence.

PHASE 2 — IVX IA PRODUCTION STABILIZATION

START:
T0 + 4 hours

TARGET END:
T0 + 72 hours

Required outcomes:

- Owner authentication stabilized.
- Owner authorization verified.
- Sessions, logout and recovery verified.
- Members and investors reconciled.
- Buyers, properties and deals reconciled.
- Cards and reels corrected.
- Chat persistence corrected.
- Keyboard and scrolling corrected.
- Android, iOS and web parity audited.
- Production APIs tested.
- Final APK generated.
- Production release deployed and verified.

PHASE 3 — FIRST 12 APP-FACTORY AGENTS

START:
T0 + 12 hours

TARGET END:
DAY 5

Required outcomes:

- First 12 factory agents specified.
- Permissions restricted.
- Sandbox environments created.
- Agent memory and task queues created.
- Tests created.
- Security review completed.
- First agents activated as soon as individually verified.
- One pilot application selected and planned from scratch.

PHASE 4 — AGENTS 13 THROUGH 30

START:
DAY 3

TARGET END:
DAY 12

Required outcomes:

- Agents 13–30 created and tested.
- Development workgroups established.
- Full application lifecycle connected.
- Agent handoff process verified.
- Pilot application moves through design, development and QA.
- Verified agents begin production work immediately.

PHASE 5 — AGENTS 31 THROUGH 50

START:
DAY 8

TARGET END:
DAY 20

Required outcomes:

- All 50 factory roles instantiated.
- Every agent has a defined purpose.
- Every agent has limited permissions.
- Every agent has an owner, supervisor and escalation route.
- Every agent has tests and performance metrics.
- Every agent appears in the dashboard.
- No unverified agent has production deployment authority.

PHASE 6 — COMPLETE APP FACTORY VALIDATION

START:
DAY 15

TARGET END:
DAY 25

Required outcomes:

- Build one complete pilot application from scratch.
- Product requirements created.
- UX and UI created.
- Architecture created.
- Frontend developed.
- Backend developed.
- Database developed.
- Mobile application developed where required.
- Authentication created.
- Automated tests completed.
- Security audit completed.
- Production infrastructure created.
- Deployment completed.
- Live application verified.
- Documentation produced.
- Monitoring activated.

PHASE 7 — FULL BUSINESS ACTIVATION

START:
Immediately after each agent is verified

TARGET END:
DAY 30 for full initial activation

Required outcomes:

- Verified IVX agents working in IVX operations.
- Verified factory agents working on application development.
- Business and engineering dashboards live.
- Two-hour reports active.
- Daily executive report active.
- Cost, productivity, evidence and quality visible.
- Owner can pause, resume or terminate any agent.
- All deployment and financial approvals remain owner-controlled.

==================================================================
4. DEFINITION OF “IVX IA SENIOR DEVELOPER COMPLETE”
==================================================================

IVX IA Senior Developer is complete only when it can prove all of the following:

1. Read the complete authorized repository.
2. Understand the active architecture.
3. Locate the source of a production defect.
4. Modify the correct files.
5. Create a valid branch.
6. Commit changes with a real SHA.
7. Run automated tests.
8. Correct failed tests.
9. Build Android, web or backend artifacts.
10. Deploy through an authorized approval gate.
11. Read deployment logs.
12. Call the live health endpoint.
13. Compare GitHub HEAD with the live runtime SHA.
14. Query Supabase safely.
15. Apply approved migrations.
16. Verify Android, iOS and web behavior.
17. Produce screenshots and logs.
18. Roll back a failed release.
19. Continue queued work after restart.
20. Report exact blockers rather than fabricate success.

Completion status must be:

VERIFIED COMPLETE

Not:

- Created.
- Configured.
- Registered.
- Active.
- Assigned.
- Appears operational.
- Narrative verified.

==================================================================
5. THE 50-AGENT APPLICATION FACTORY
==================================================================

Create these 50 independent application-development agents.

LEADERSHIP AND PRODUCT

01. AI Factory Commander
02. Portfolio Strategy AI
03. Product Research AI
04. Market Validation AI
05. Product Manager AI
06. Requirements Analyst AI
07. Project Planning AI
08. Scrum and Workflow AI

DESIGN AND EXPERIENCE

09. UX Research AI
10. User Journey AI
11. UI Design AI
12. Design System AI
13. Mobile Experience AI
14. Web Experience AI
15. Accessibility AI
16. Content and UX Writing AI

ARCHITECTURE AND DEVELOPMENT

17. Solution Architect AI
18. Technical Lead AI
19. Frontend Web AI
20. React Native Mobile AI
21. iOS Engineering AI
22. Android Engineering AI
23. Backend API AI
24. Database Engineering AI
25. Authentication AI
26. Integration Engineering AI
27. Realtime Systems AI
28. Media and Storage AI
29. Payments Integration AI
30. AI and Automation Integration AI
31. Data Engineering AI
32. Analytics Engineering AI
33. Performance Engineering AI
34. Migration and Legacy Systems AI

QUALITY, SECURITY AND DEPLOYMENT

35. Unit Testing AI
36. Integration Testing AI
37. End-to-End Testing AI
38. Mobile Device QA AI
39. Web Browser QA AI
40. Security Engineering AI
41. Privacy and Compliance AI
42. Code Review AI
43. DevOps AI
44. Cloud Infrastructure AI
45. Release Management AI
46. Monitoring and Reliability AI
47. Incident Response AI

BUSINESS LAUNCH AND SUPPORT

48. Technical Documentation AI
49. Application Marketing and Launch AI
50. Customer Support and Product Feedback AI

==================================================================
6. AGENT CREATION PIPELINE
==================================================================

Every agent must follow this process:

SPECIFICATION
→ TOOL SELECTION
→ PERMISSION DEFINITION
→ DATA-ACCESS DEFINITION
→ PROHIBITED-ACTION DEFINITION
→ SANDBOX CREATION
→ TEST CREATION
→ CAPABILITY TEST
→ SECURITY TEST
→ QA REVIEW
→ OWNER APPROVAL WHEN REQUIRED
→ VERIFIED COMPLETE
→ BUSINESS-WORKFLOW ASSIGNMENT
→ LIVE MONITORING
→ PERFORMANCE REVIEW

An agent cannot be considered complete because its name or profile was created.

==================================================================
7. IMMEDIATE BUSINESS-WORKFLOW ACTIVATION
==================================================================

As soon as an agent becomes VERIFIED COMPLETE, add it immediately to the proper workflow.

Do not wait for all 50 agents.

Use this rule:

IF AGENT STATUS = VERIFIED COMPLETE
THEN:
1. Register the agent in the production agent directory.
2. Assign its supervisor.
3. Assign its authorized tools.
4. Assign its business or development queue.
5. Assign its first real task.
6. Record the start time.
7. Start heartbeat monitoring.
8. Record output and evidence.
9. Include it in the next two-hour report.
10. Measure quality, speed, cost and failure rate.

==================================================================
8. IVX BUSINESS WORKFLOW
==================================================================

Add verified IVX operational agents to this flow:

OWNER VISION
→ CHIEF OPERATING AI
→ BUSINESS PRIORITY
→ TASK CREATION
→ AGENT ASSIGNMENT
→ EXECUTION
→ QA
→ SECURITY REVIEW
→ OWNER APPROVAL WHEN REQUIRED
→ PRODUCTION OR BUSINESS ACTIVATION
→ KPI MEASUREMENT
→ CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

INVESTOR WORKFLOW

Investor Acquisition AI
→ Lead Validation
→ CRM and Lead Matching
→ Qualification
→ Deal Matching
→ Compliance Review
→ Owner-Approved Communication
→ Follow-Up
→ Commitment Tracking
→ Investor Reporting

BUYER WORKFLOW

Buyer Acquisition AI
→ Buyer Validation
→ Requirements Capture
→ Property Matching
→ Follow-Up
→ Appointment or Offer
→ Deal Pipeline
→ Closing Support
→ CRM Reporting

DEAL WORKFLOW

Opportunity Discovery
→ Data Verification
→ Financial Analysis
→ Documents and Media
→ Compliance Review
→ Owner Approval
→ Investor and Buyer Matching
→ Funding or Sale Pipeline
→ Project Monitoring
→ Distribution and Reporting

MARKETING WORKFLOW

Content Planning
→ Owner or Policy Approval
→ Content Creation
→ QA
→ Publication
→ Lead Capture
→ CRM Sync
→ Follow-Up
→ Conversion Measurement

==================================================================
9. APPLICATION FACTORY WORKFLOW
==================================================================

Every application created from scratch must follow:

IDEA
→ MARKET RESEARCH
→ BUSINESS CASE
→ OWNER SELECTION
→ PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS
→ UX RESEARCH
→ UI DESIGN
→ TECHNICAL ARCHITECTURE
→ DEVELOPMENT PLAN
→ FRONTEND DEVELOPMENT
→ BACKEND DEVELOPMENT
→ DATABASE DEVELOPMENT
→ MOBILE DEVELOPMENT
→ INTEGRATIONS
→ AUTOMATED TESTING
→ SECURITY REVIEW
→ PERFORMANCE TESTING
→ OWNER ACCEPTANCE
→ DEPLOYMENT
→ LIVE VERIFICATION
→ MONITORING
→ MARKETING LAUNCH
→ CUSTOMER FEEDBACK
→ CONTINUOUS DEVELOPMENT

No new application may access IVX production investors, buyers, money or confidential data by default.

==================================================================
10. FACTORY ISOLATION
==================================================================

The 50-agent factory must remain separate from the IVX production platform.

Required separation:

- Separate repositories.
- Separate cloud projects.
- Separate databases.
- Separate secrets.
- Separate deployment pipelines.
- Separate logging.
- Separate budgets.
- Separate production approval.
- Separate customer data.
- Separate domain configuration.
- Separate incident controls.

Factory agents may only access IVX production after explicit owner authorization for a specific task.

==================================================================
11. REAL START AND END TIME FOR EVERY AGENT
==================================================================

Display this information for every agent:

| Field | Requirement |
| Agent number | 01–50 or IVX operational number |
| Agent name | Exact registered name |
| Purpose | One primary responsibility |
| Build start | Actual timestamp |
| Target completion | Planned timestamp |
| Actual completion | Real timestamp |
| Security result | Pass or fail |
| QA result | Pass or fail |
| Production-ready | Yes or no |
| Workflow assignment | Exact workflow |
| Work activation | Actual timestamp |
| First task | Real task ID |
| Last heartbeat | Actual timestamp |
| Current status | Exact status |
| Evidence | Logs, tests and outputs |

Allowed agent statuses:

- NOT STARTED.
- BUILDING.
- CONFIGURING TOOLS.
- SANDBOX TESTING.
- SECURITY REVIEW.
- QA REVIEW.
- OWNER APPROVAL REQUIRED.
- VERIFIED COMPLETE.
- ASSIGNED TO WORKFLOW.
- WORKING.
- BLOCKED WITH EXACT ERROR.
- FAILED.
- PAUSED.
- TERMINATED.

==================================================================
12. PARALLEL EXECUTION RULE
==================================================================

Do not build agents only one at a time when dependencies permit parallel work.

Use controlled workstreams:

WORKSTREAM A:
Complete IVX IA Senior Developer and IVX production stabilization.

WORKSTREAM B:
Create the first 12 factory agents.

WORKSTREAM C:
Prepare factory infrastructure, isolation, queues and dashboard.

WORKSTREAM D:
Define the pilot application.

WORKSTREAM E:
Build and test agents 13–30.

WORKSTREAM F:
Build and test agents 31–50.

Parallel execution must not allow conflicting repository edits, uncontrolled deployments or duplicated work.

==================================================================
13. FIRST PILOT APPLICATION
==================================================================

Do not claim that the factory can create applications from scratch until it completes one pilot application.

The owner must select or approve the pilot.

The pilot must prove:

- Original requirements.
- Working product design.
- Owner-controlled repository.
- Working frontend.
- Working backend.
- Working database.
- Authentication.
- Mobile or web application as required.
- Automated testing.
- Security review.
- Build artifacts.
- Production deployment.
- Monitoring.
- Documentation.
- Owner acceptance.

The pilot must remain independent of the current IVX production application.

==================================================================
14. DASHBOARD REQUIREMENTS
==================================================================

Create two dashboard areas:

A. IVX BUSINESS OPERATIONS

Show:

- Investors.
- Buyers.
- Deals.
- Marketing.
- CRM.
- Finance.
- Customer support.
- Security.
- Current agent tasks.
- Completed business outputs.
- Revenue and conversion metrics.
- Alerts.
- Owner approvals.

B. 50-AGENT APPLICATION FACTORY

Show:

- Agents planned.
- Agents building.
- Agents in testing.
- Agents verified.
- Agents assigned.
- Applications proposed.
- Applications approved.
- Applications in development.
- Builds.
- Deployments.
- Defects.
- Costs.
- Completion estimates.
- Last heartbeat.
- Evidence.

==================================================================
15. TWO-HOUR REPORT
==================================================================

Post every two hours inside IVX AI Chat:

- Current date and time.
- Time since execution started.
- IVX IA completion percentage.
- IVX production completion percentage.
- Number of factory agents not started.
- Number building.
- Number testing.
- Number verified.
- Number assigned to workflows.
- Number currently working.
- Tasks completed.
- Commits created.
- Tests executed.
- Deployments completed.
- Business results produced.
- Applications being developed.
- Blockers.
- Owner approvals required.
- Forecast for the next two hours.
- Expected master completion date.

Do not report percentages unless supported by completed acceptance criteria.

==================================================================
16. OWNER APPROVAL GATES
==================================================================

Owner approval is required before:

- Production deployment.
- Production database-destructive operation.
- Moving money.
- Investor financial commitments.
- Tokenized investment publication.
- New production application launch.
- Giving factory agents access to IVX production.
- Increasing an agent’s permissions.
- Deleting production records.
- Disabling security controls.

Routine testing and sandbox development do not require repeated approval after the owner has approved the project scope.

==================================================================
17. NON-NEGOTIABLE RULES
==================================================================

- Do not fabricate agents.
- Do not fabricate activity.
- Do not fabricate timestamps.
- Do not call an agent complete without testing.
- Do not call a queue 24/7 if it stops after the chat closes.
- Do not report simulated work as live execution.
- Do not count test records as investors or buyers.
- Do not expose secrets.
- Do not give unrestricted permissions.
- Do not deploy without verification.
- Do not wait for all agents before activating verified agents.
- Do not mix the 50-agent factory with IVX production infrastructure.
- Do not let Rork retain exclusive control.
- Do not substitute dashboards and reports for actual execution.

==================================================================
18. FIRST RESPONSE REQUIRED
==================================================================

Return this table using real current results:

| Item | Required result |
| Mandate received | Timestamp |
| Execution started | Timestamp |
| Master target end | Date and time |
| IVX IA Senior Developer | Current status |
| IVX IA target completion | Date and time |
| Production stabilization target | Date and time |
| Factory infrastructure | Current status |
| Factory Agent 01–12 | Individual status and target |
| Factory Agent 13–30 | Start and target |
| Factory Agent 31–50 | Start and target |
| Verified agents | Count and names |
| Agents assigned to workflows | Count and assignments |
| Agents currently working | Count and real task IDs |
| Pilot application | Selected or awaiting owner selection |
| Active repository | Repository and branch |
| GitHub HEAD | Full SHA |
| Production deployment | ID and status |
| Dashboard URL | Live URL |
| Emergency stop | Test result |
| Next two-hour report | Exact scheduled time |
| Current blockers | Exact evidence |

==================================================================
19. FINAL ACCEPTANCE
==================================================================

The program is accepted only when:

- IVX IA Senior Developer is fully tool-enabled.
- IVX IA completed at least one real code-to-production cycle.
- Existing IVX production is stabilized and verified.
- All 50 factory agents have completed security and QA.
- Each verified agent is assigned to an active workflow.
- The factory created one independent application from scratch.
- The pilot application is deployed and live.
- Every deployment has evidence.
- Owner controls are verified.
- Emergency-stop controls are verified.
- Factory systems remain isolated from IVX production.
- Live dashboard and reporting are operational.

Allowed final response:

VERIFIED COMPLETE — WITH EVIDENCE

or:

PARTIALLY COMPLETE — EXACT ITEMS REMAINING

or:

BLOCKED — EXACT TECHNICAL EVIDENCE

Do not return “completed in full” merely because agents were registered or tasks were assigned.
